verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API spec is a fair ask for an API-first product like Stripe Issuing, so the axis applies. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json). The llms.txt file and markdown API reference pages are LLM-friendly docs, not a structured API spec, and the pack has no other evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent file.
